meta.disclaimer: Analysis only. Counts are from the 200-post human-reviewed sample unless marked full_table (n=1544). No accuracy claim.

A_proposal_summary.interpretation: 66/136 (49%) are confirmations to lock in as hard rules; 70/136 (51%) are corrections concentrated in category over-tagging (41) and department over-inference (26); stakeholder had zero proposals.

B_proposed_rules.problem: Admission promos, job ads, greetings, thanks must never be activities even when they contain activity-like words.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 27/27 sample NON_ACTIVITY confirmed, group F=0; full_table NON_ACTIVITY=102 (admission_promo 41, job_ad 31, greeting 21, thanks 9).
B_proposed_rules.current_behavior: communication_type + communication_only flag; status NON_ACTIVITY; category strings may remain attached.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Hard rule: communication_type in {admission_promo, job_ad, greeting, thanks, announcement} => NON_ACTIVITY, except guarded embedded-event promotion (RULE-02b).
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: embedded event inside a promo (0 observed; keep promotion guard)

B_proposed_rules.problem: Communication posts carry category keywords as program features, polluting category statistics.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 20 comm_mention_context notes; full_table 52/102 NON_ACTIVITY posts carry >=1 category (RESEARCH 43, ACHIEVEMENT 25, INTERNSHIP 10, PLACEMENT 10, ALUMNI 8, INDUSTRY 7, CAMPUS 2).
B_proposed_rules.current_behavior: communication_override noted but category strings remain stored/visible on candidate rows.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: For NON_ACTIVITY rows suppress categories from display/export (retain raw values in internal column as category_context); never count toward activity stats.
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: if post later promoted to activity, re-evaluate categories from text rather than restoring blindly

B_proposed_rules.problem: A genuine event embedded in a communication post must remain promotable to activity.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: Group F = 0/27 in sample; unfired but not disproven.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Keep as guard; require strong event term + explicit date before promotion; do not tune thresholds from this sample.
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: removing it would FN future embedded events

B_proposed_rules.problem: ACHIEVEMENT over-tagged on promos, ceremonies, remembrance and institutional-status posts.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 21/21 flagged = corrections (21/39 group-B posts, 18% of 116 activity sample); full_table ACHIEVEMENT on 491/1280 activity candidates.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Require an achievement instance: award won, result declared, person/team recognised, certification counts published. Event announcements, promos, remembrance and institutional-status news do not qualify.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: auto-drop would remove true achievements (NPTEL results, placements) - keep as verify/flag until scored against human labels
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: low when used only as flag

B_proposed_rules.problem: RESEARCH over-tagged on alumni-spotlight, award, fellowship and greeting posts where research only appears in profile/institutional lines.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 11/11 flagged = corrections; full_table RESEARCH on 351/1280 activity candidates.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Require a research activity instance: seminar/conclave/paper/journal/funding event or published result; organizer evidence (R&D Cell, Research Council) or event evidence required; profile mentions and institutional titles do not qualify.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: auto-drop may remove legitimate 'congratulations for research grant' posts
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: low with organizer/event evidence retained (69, 89, 92 keep RESEARCH)

B_proposed_rules.problem: INDUSTRY added from academic MoUs and title adjectives ('Industry Innovation').
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 4/4 flagged = corrections; full_table INDUSTRY on 69 activity candidates.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Require an industry actor: company/corporate partner name, 'in association with <industry body>', sponsorship by industry. Academic MoUs and title adjectives do not qualify.
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: informal industry-partner naming may be missed

B_proposed_rules.problem: ALUMNI added to graduation/training posts where alumni are not the audience or subject.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 3/3 flagged = corrections; full_table ALUMNI on 179 activity candidates (high base rate).
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: ALUMNI only for alumni meet/chapter events, alumni spotlight features, alumni-authored or alumni-audience activities; graduation/farewell => ORIENTATION, not ALUMNI.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: moderate if keyword-only again; require audience semantics
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: legitimate uses must survive: 115 (TCE USA Alumni Meet), 118 (alumni congratulation), 23 (alumni spotlight)

B_proposed_rules.problem: INTERNSHIP attached because the word appears as a program feature or profile line.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 2/2 flagged = corrections; full_table INTERNSHIP on 167 activity candidates (high base rate, small sample evidence).
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: INTERNSHIP only when the post is about an internship (posting, completion, drive, internship event) - not a feature bullet inside another activity; keep when the achievement subject IS the internship (13-style).
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: over-pruning internship-achievement posts if applied broadly

B_proposed_rules.problem: One event gets two categories that are format/venue synonyms.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 3/3 flagged = corrections; full_table 767/1280 activity candidates are multi-label (498 with exactly 2) but only 3 judged overlapping.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Collapse only within a curated synonym-pair list (CONFERENCE+WEBINAR -> CONFERENCE; SYMPOSIUM+TECH_FEST -> SYMPOSIUM; CONFERENCE+GUEST_LECTURE -> dominant) when they describe the SAME event; distinct event types stay multi-label.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: generic collapsing would flatten legitimate multi-distinct activities (e.g. FDP+SEMINAR)

B_proposed_rules.problem: Department inferred from topic/technology/course names instead of organizer/host/participation evidence.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 26 department corrections across 14 sample posts, all unanimous; triggers Chemistry 7, AMCS 6, EEE 6, AI 6, T'SEDA 1; full_table AC/RR carrying these depts: AMCS 88, AI 69, Chemistry 38, EEE 131; journal CFP fan-out posts (486/567/601/660) contribute 16 of 26.
B_proposed_rules.current_behavior: topic/technology/course keywords mapped to departments; no organizer requirement.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Require explicit participation evidence ('Department of X', 'organized/hosted by X', department association/club, named coordinator); otherwise display value = General, raw inference kept in internal column. Scope statements and journal CFP topic lists => General.
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: unusual organizer phrasing (initials 'Dept. of ECE', 'team from ECE') - mitigate with alias/initials matcher; counter-example 50 shows explicit 'Department of Physics' must be kept

B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: No change; re-evaluate only after classifier scored against human labels.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: any change now would be unevidenced

B_proposed_rules.problem: Pressure to resolve ambiguous multi-year dates, invent dates for undated posts, or infer AY from workbook sheet names.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: 19 date notes (15 multi_year_keep, 4 pre_2024_keep), all 'keep as-is'; full_table date_status: undated 829, dated 699, ambiguous_multi_year 16; multi_year flag 16, pre_2024_ambiguous 4.
B_proposed_rules.current_behavior: explicit dates only (June 1 - May 31 AY); ambiguous_multi_year flagged; undated stays undated; pre-2024 flagged.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Lock as invariants: (1) no date without explicit text evidence; (2) never collapse multi-year to one AY; (3) undated stays undated; (4) never infer AY from sheet names/sheet period; (5) pre-2024 stays flagged for scope confirmation, not deleted.
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: collapsing multi-year loses real ambiguity (415/419 five-date spans)

B_proposed_rules.problem: 57 posts in REVIEW_REQUIRED with heterogeneous causes; downstream cannot tell why they are unclear.
B_proposed_rules.evidence: Group G = 57: weak_text 19, text_is_url 6, url_only 5, link_less 4, multi_year 1, unflagged-low-score 37; evidence_score bands: 0 x19, 1-3 x30, 4-7 x8; 53/57 have URL, 4 do not.
B_proposed_rules.current_behavior: single REVIEW_REQUIRED status; flags coarse; 37 posts have no flag.
B_proposed_rules.proposed_behavior: Attach machine-readable unclear_reason in {url_only, text_is_url, title_only, link_less_weak, low_evidence_event_like, non_latin_unmatched, multi_year}; route url_only/text_is_url to URL-resolve queue, title_only/low_evidence to human queue.
B_proposed_rules.fp_risk: low (routing metadata only, no classification change)
B_proposed_rules.fn_risk: mis-binned reason codes affect queue prioritisation only

C_category_findings.dominant_problem: ACHIEVEMENT (21 corrections) with four failure families: memorial/remembrance (29,747,1519), program promos (34,164), event announcements without results (45,47,50,57,61,90), institutional status news (170,171,1125).
C_category_findings.research: 11 corrections driven by profile/recognition/greeting mentions (11,12,13,15,25,31,73); legitimate event uses remain (69,89,92).
C_category_findings.industry: 4 corrections: academic MoU mistaken for industry collaboration (17,18); title adjectives (75,394).
C_category_findings.alumni: 3 corrections: audience confusion with graduation/training (61,140,149); high base rate 179.
C_category_findings.placement_campus: 0 over-tag flags in sample; keep on watch list only.
C_category_findings.multi_label_overlap: 3/767 multi-label rows judged overlapping; collapse only curated pairs; multi-label itself accepted (group A contains 23,38,93,99...).
C_category_findings.ordering: Communication suppression (RULE-02) must run before category gates (52/102 NA posts carry categories).

course_program_name: 426 STTP 'Next Gen Tools' -> AMCS+AI although organizer is CSBS
journal_cfp_fanout: 660 (16 of 26 corrections from 4 posts x 4 inferred departments)

D_department_findings.counter_example: post 50 explicitly names Department of Physics - keep named dept, drop inferred Chemistry
D_department_findings.policy: department requires explicit organize/host/participate evidence; otherwise display value = General with raw inference retained internally

E_communication_findings.category_leakage: 52/102 NA posts carry >=1 category (RESEARCH 43, ACHIEVEMENT 25, INTERNSHIP 10, PLACEMENT 10, ALUMNI 8, INDUSTRY 7, CAMPUS 2)
E_communication_findings.context_split: congratulation/thanks wording is NA at post level but keeps ACHIEVEMENT inside activity posts (118) - gate on post-level communication_type, not sentence keywords
E_communication_findings.promotion_guard: keep RULE-02b; unfired (0) means untuned, not unnecessary
E_communication_findings.lexicon_gap: Tamil festival greetings (74,126,269) fell into unclear kind I instead of greeting

multi_year_keep.action: keep ambiguous_multi_year; never collapse to one AY

pre_2024_keep.action: keep flagged for scope confirmation; do not delete or reassign

F_date_findings.undated: 829/1544 full table remain undated; no proposals asked to date them
F_date_findings.sheet_name_inference: none observed in any proposal; ban preserved

G_rules_not_to_generalize: Do NOT auto-drop over-tagged categories before scoring against the 200 human labels (50/136 proposals are low-confidence 'verify' phrasing).
Do NOT build a generic multi-label overlap merger - only 3 instances, curated pairs only (RULE-08).
Do NOT touch stakeholder logic - 0/136 proposals, no evidence.
Do NOT auto-promote or auto-demote communication posts - group F = 0 gives no calibration data.
Do NOT fix ambiguous multi-year or pre-2024 dates - preservation only (RULE-11).
Do NOT infer department from scope statements or journal CFP topic lists; equally do NOT blanket-remove departments with explicit organizer evidence (post 50).
Do NOT confuse review groups A-H with screening kinds A-J - different taxonomies.
Do NOT delete or rewrite the 1544 candidate rows based on this analysis - application requires explicit next-stage approval.

category_layer: Add evidence gates RULE-03..07 (flag/score-penalty first; auto-drop only after evaluation)
Suppress categories on NON_ACTIVITY rows at display (RULE-02)
Keep PLACEMENT/CAMPUS on watch list (0 sample flags; base rates 27/58)
department_layer: Organizer-evidence requirement with alias/initials matcher (ECE/EEE/CSE/MECH/CIVIL, 'Dept. of', 'organized by', coordinator lines)
Fallback display value = General; raw inference in internal column
Journal CFP and institution-wide events => General
date_layer: Encode RULE-11 as invariant assertions + regression tests
unclear_layer: Split 57 into queues: URL-resolve 14, human-title ~8, low-evidence event-like 37

Investigate kind-I event-like cluster (44,49,53,54,55 boot camp recaps; 108,429 inaugurations; 230 contest; 141,396 series) - candidate lexicon additions: inaugurat*, boot camp, contest, lecture series
H_recommended_changes.evaluation_precondition: Score the classifier against the 200 human labels (groups A-H + 70 accepted corrections) to measure precision/recall per rule before any rule is enabled automatically.

recurring_patterns.pattern: text_is_url (post text is just a link)
unflagged but low evidence (score 0-4, kind I)
recurring_patterns.note: sub-patterns: Tamil festival greetings 74/126/269 should route to greeting/NON_ACTIVITY; project-sanction congratulations 369/370/371 look like ACHIEVEMENT; event-like posts with dates (108,141,204,213,230,234,269,396,409,416,429,431) likely activities missed by event-term lexicon; boot-camp recaps 44/49/53/54/55
recurring_patterns.routing: human low-evidence queue + lexicon gap review

unclear_records_analysis.conclusion: The 57 are not one population: ~14 are mechanically unresolvable (URL-only), ~8 are title-only, ~1 is date-ambiguity, and ~34 are genuine classification misses (lexicon gaps: inaugurations, boot camps, contests, series, Tamil greetings, congratulation-for-grant posts).
